calibration_note: Maps the model output to the share of past cases that reached the target before the stop (walk-forward predictions of the 4-hour model, 2023-01-01 to 2025-10-01).
policy_note: The 4-hour model is read at every 15-minute close, on the 4-hour candle that ends at that close. A coin gets a signal when the model's score is in its top 0.5% (the level chosen for this stream on the validation years). One trade at a time per coin, a cooldown of 8 candles of 15 minutes, at most 1 new signal per 15-minute candle (the highest score).
plan_note: Stop 2 x ATR(14) of the 4-hour candles from the entry (1R). One target at 0.5R: the whole position closes there and the stop never moves. Time limit 864 candles of 15 minutes (9 days).
selection_note: Chosen on the validation years before the holdout was opened (research/v5/rolling15.py): the pre-registered setting (the 4h model's own level, 3 signals per candle) passed the validation rule but gave 11.5 signals a day and a -257R drawdown.

test.note: Walk-forward on data the models never saw (every fold was scored by a model trained only on candles from before the fold), 15-minute decisions, entries at the price one minute after the 15-minute candle closed, 0.30% fees and slippage per round trip plus funding for longs. A win = the target was reached before the stop.

validation_rule: validation: win rate >= 73%, average >= +0.05R after costs, profit factor >= 1.15, at least 150 signals, every validation year (30+ signals) >= 68% wins with a positive average, and the next stricter score level holds up too (so the strictest level tried can never be chosen). Among the settings that pass and give at least one signal a day: the steadiest one (highest Sharpe ratio of the daily results), preferring the simplest plan (one target, no cost cap, no higher-timeframe check) when its Sharpe ratio is within 10% of the best
research: research/v5/lab5.py (the 4-hour model) and research/v5/rolling15.py (read every 15 minutes)
